excerpt: The Consumer Price Index for New York-Newark-Jersey City rose 1.0% in April 2026, with a 4.6% increase over the past 12 months. The energy index surged 24.0% and the food index rose 4.9% over the same period. The index for all items less food and energy increased 3.3%.
